verdict.rationale: GitLab Duo agents can turn natural-language issue descriptions into merge requests and perform code review/remediation, and there's an official MCP server enabling natural-language-driven agent interaction with GitLab. However, evidence doesn't show broad natural-language control of core GitLab operations (project admin, CI config, permissions) beyond these agentic workflows. Missing for 10: documentation of natural-language commands covering the full platform (not just issue-to-MR agents), independent hands-on validation of NL command reliability.
